title: The car that told CJ the truth in GTA San Andreas
subject: cj
description:
Did you see Big Smoke's betrayal coming? 👇

The green Sabre and the secret behind Beverly Johnson's death. Spoilers for GTA San Andreas.

scenes.text: A green Sabre told CJ who got his mother killed.
In 1992, the Ballas used that car in the drive-by that killed Beverly Johnson. The bullets were meant for Sweet.
Big Smoke and Ryder stood with the family at her funeral.
Then, in the mission The Green Sabre, CJ spotted the car at a quiet meeting.
Smoke and Ryder were next to it, with the Ballas and Officer Tenpenny.
That night Sweet was shot, and the police dumped CJ in the countryside.
Smoke's famous Cluckin' Bell order hits different once you know he was working for Tenpenny.
